key_definitions.full: op plus ordered input/output dtype, ne, nb; excludes ids, names, request/group identity, addresses and storage metadata
key_definitions.gemm_mnk: MUL_MAT only: op, M=output.ne[0], N=output.ne[1], K=input[0].ne[0]
key_definitions.op_output_shape: all vision ops: op plus output.ne; intentionally drops dtype, strides and inputs
